text:
Maya (Marketing PM): Quick sync — planning customer case for the Launch Insights webinar with EmberWorks. Need interview + a short quote for the marketing page, legal sign-off, and lead-routing for registrants. Timeline: webinar on 2026-05-12. Can we lock the interview this week?

Ethan (PMM): I can run the interview. Customer availability windows? 30–45m convo + 10m for quote capture. Prefer prepped Qs. Samples of quote language below.

Ethan (PMM): Suggested time slots:
```
- Thu 2026-04-30 10:00-11:00 PT
- Fri 2026-05-01 14:00-14:45 PT
```

Priya (Legal): We need a signed release + approved quote language before publish. Use the legal template (Marketing > Releases). Please share proposed quote and a signed release to legal@redwood.com by EOD Thu so we can turn around.

Maya (Marketing PM): Thanks Priya. I'll drop the draft quote in this thread today. Do we need redactions for customer metrics? @Priya

Priya (Legal): If figures are sensitive, request the non-identifying phrasing. Example: `reduced inference cost by ~30%` instead of exact dollars. Also confirm customer consent for name/logo usage.

Luis (Demand Gen): For lead routing — plan to create SFDC campaign `LaunchInsights_2026_05`. Can we add UTM campaign: `utm_campaign=launch_insights_may26`? Also, mark registrants with Lead Source = Webinar and flow to MQL queue. Who owns follow-ups?

Tanya (AE): I'll own post-webinar demo follow-ups. @Luis please route leads with `Owner = pipeline_education` or tag `tanya-ae` so I get notified. :slightly_smiling_face: 

Sam (Producer): Recording logistics: we can do remote Zoom + local backup. If customer wants a polished clip, we need 10–15m extra for B-roll/questions. Prefer the Fri slot. Need speaker headshots and short bio 48h before.

Maya (Marketing PM): Draft quote (for legal review): "Using Redwood Inference, EmberWorks cut inference latency by ~35% and reduced per-request cost significantly — enabling a new realtime feature for our customers." Will paste more exact Qs.

Priya (Legal): I can work with that wording. Two notes: change "reduced per-request cost significantly" -> replace with non-quantitative phrasing or get approval for exact %. If they approve %, we'll include the number.

Ethan (PMM): Interview outline (short):
1) Problem and baseline infra
2) Why Redwood
3) Measurable impact (latency/cost)
4) Quote capture
5) Any cautionary notes for other teams

Maya (Marketing PM): @Sam can you create a user-friendly release form link? Also, Sam — can you confirm Zoom recording + captions?

Sam (Producer): Yep. I'll spin up a release doc (Google) and add captions workflow. Will post link in thread by EOD.

recording-bot: Meeting created: "Launch Insights — EmberWorks interview" Thu 2026-04-30 10:00 PT. Zoom link -> https://zoom.example/meet/12345

Luis (Demand Gen): Thanks — once recording is up, I'll push a registration reminder email and set up the SFDC campaign. Please pin tracking URLs in thread.

Maya (Marketing PM): Next steps: 1) Priya to confirm release template & quick redlines (by Thu EOD). 2) Sam to post release doc + Zoom. 3) Ethan to confirm customer availability. 4) Luis & Tanya to set up SFDC campaign & routing. I'll update the project card in Asana.

Tanya (AE): Adding: please tag me on registrant list export so I can prep demo deck.

Ethan (PMM): I have the customer contact on standby. I'll confirm the Fri slot if Thu doesn't work.

Maya (Marketing PM): Awesome — keeping momentum. :rocket:
